body.en:
Definition

Generator differential protection compares corresponding stator terminal and neutral-end phase currents to detect internal faults within the CT bounded winding zone.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Phase CT s at both stator ends feed differential relay; output goes through approved lockout/trip paths to generator breaker, field and prime-mover systems.

Working / operating sequence

  1. Compare compensated phasors, apply pickup/bias and trip assigned outputs only for an asserted internal condition.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Use consistent into-zone polarities and phase matching.Through load/external fault ideally balance; internal fault produces operating current.
  • Bias improves stability for CT errors; winding interturn faults within one phase may not produce sufficient phase differential and can need specialised split-phase/interturn protection.
  • The trip matrix can de-excite, isolate source paths and trip prime mover as approved; relay 87 Gis not a universal wiring order.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Generator differential terminal/neutral-end phase currents compare કરી CT bounded winding માં internal fault શોધે છે.

Construction / ભાગો તથા જોડાણ

  1. બંને stator ends CT→diff relay→approved lockout/GCB/field/prime mover.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Phasor compare/pickup-bias પછી internal condition માં assigned trip.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Into-zone polarity/phase match; load/external balance/internal માં difference.
  • Bias CT errorsrestrain; એક phase interturn માં phase-diff પૂરતુંનહોય, special scheme જોઈએ.
  • Approved matrix de-excite/source isolate/prime mover trip કરે; 87 Guniversalwiringorder નથી.

title.en: 4.2 Stator earth fault: neutral displacement and coverage
title.gu: 4.2 Stator Earth Fault: Neutral Displacement તથા Coverage

h.en: Stator earth fault: neutral displacement and coverage
h.gu: Stator Earth Fault: Neutral Displacement તથા Coverage

body.en:
Definition

Stator earth-fault protection detects insulation failure between the generator stator circuit and earth using quantities appropriate to its neutral-earthing arrangement.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Fundamental neutral voltage/current methods depend on fault location and grounding impedance; faults near neutral may produce a weak signal, so claimed coverage must be stated.
  • “95%”and“100%”are scheme objectives, not guarantees from a single neutral resistor.Third-harmonic or injection-based methods can extend coverage with application-specific checks.
  • Generator operating state, third-harmonic distribution and connected transformer capacitances affect performance; tests must include offline/startup conditions where required.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Stator earth protection neutral earthing મુજબ stator-earth insulation fault શોધે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Fundamentalneutral V/Ilocation-grounding પર; near-neutral weak signal થી coverage સ્પષ્ટકરો.
  • 95%/100%scheme objectives છે, single NER guarantee નહીં; third harmonic/injection extend કરી શકે.
  • Operating state/third harmonic/transformer C અસરકરે; required offline/startup checks કરો.

h.en: Rotor earth fault and field failure
h.gu: Rotor Earth Fault તથા Field Failure

body.en:
Definition

Rotor earth-fault protection supervises insulation of the field circuit to earth; field-failure protection detects loss or severe inadequacy of excitation while the generator is connected.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Afirst field earth in an otherwise unearthed field circuit may cause little fault current but leaves a dangerous second-fault risk; alarm/trip stages follow plant policy.
  • Two earth points can short part of the field winding, create unbalance/heating and mechanical vibration.Rotor earth monitoring often uses injection/bridge techniques.
  • Loss of excitation can cause reactive-power absorption, rotor/stator heating and instability; impedance/reactive/capability-supervised methods distinguish it from permissible swings.
  • Rotor earth and field failure are different phenomena; one healthy monitor does not prove the other protection is unnecessary.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Rotor-earth field circuit-earth insulation જુએ; field failure connected generator નું excitation loss/inadequacy શોધે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Unearthed field માં firstearthlow I હોઈશકેપણ second fault ખતરનાક; alarm/trip policy મુજબ.
  • Two earth points field short/unbalance/heat-vibration; monitoring injection/bridge થી.
  • Excitation los s Q absorption/heat/instability આપે; Z/Q/capability supervision permissible swing થીઅલગકરે.
  • Rotor earth/field failure જુદાં; એક healthy માટેબીજું unnecessary નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Reverse-power protection detects sustained real power flowing from the system into a generator that is expected to deliver power, indicating motoring when mechanical input is inadequate.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Turbine/diesel/hydro motoring limits differ; pickup and delay must follow prime-mover capability and synchronising/transient behaviour, not a universal percentage.
  • Balanced P=√3 VLLI cosφwith the declared export-positive sign.Low forward power is not identical to negative power; both can be used in a designed turbine-trip sequence.
  • CT/VT polarity and phase association are critical.Awrong sign can turn healthy export into a false motoring indication.

Worked example / setting interpretation

  1. For a declared 100 MVA unit, a classroom threshold−2 MW is 2%of MVA expressed as MW base, not a recommended setting.Time qualification should reject brief transients.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Reverse power expected generating unit માં system થી sustained real power અંદરઆવેતે motoring શોધે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Turbine/diesel/hydro limits જુદા; pickup/delay capability/transients મુજબ, universal percent નહીં.
  • Balanced P=√3 VLLI cosφ/export positive; low forward/negative P અલગ, sequence માંવપરાય.
  • CT/VT polarity/phasing critical; wrong sign healthy export ને false motoring બનાવે.

ઉકેલેલું ઉદાહરણ / Settingનું અર્થઘટન

  1. Declared 100 MVA unit માં classroom−2 MW=2%MVA ના MW base; recommended setting નહીં; delay brief transient reject કરે.

h.en: Pole slipping, out-of-step and power swings
h.gu: Pole Slipping, Out-of-step તથા Power Swings

body.en:
Definition

Pole slipping is loss of synchronism in which the generator rotor electrical angle moves through successive cycles relative to the system; out-of-step protection identifies an unstable trajectory for controlled separation.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Astable power swing is not automatically a fault or pole slip.R–Xtrajectory, rate of travers al and blocking/tripping logic discriminate conditions.
  • Separation location/time must consider transient torque, voltage and stability studies.The purpose is controlled damage limitation, not arbitrary fast disconnection on any oscillation.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Pole slipping માં rotor angle system નીસામેસતત cycles સરકે; out-of-step unstable trajectory ઓળખી controlled separation કરે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Stable swing automatic fault/pole slip નહીં; R–Xpath/rate/logic discriminate કરે.
  • Separation time/location torque/V/stability study થી; દર oscillation પર arbitrary fast trip નહીં.

body.en:
Definition

Generator backup/abnormal-condition protection supervises conditions outside the main differential zone or beyond machine capability while coordinating with system recovery requirements.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Thermal overload uses current/temperature/time capability; RTD s, cooling state and negative-sequence heating may be separate inputs.
  • Backup impedance uses apparent impedance with time/swing/load supervision to clear external faults if primary protection fails; load must not be mistaken for a short.
  • Underfrequency stages coordinate turbine blade/time limits, system load shedding and is landing policy; an immediate trip on any frequency dip may worsen the grid disturbance.
  • Numerical relay block: CT/VT/RTD/binary inputs→conditioned ADC/logic→87G, 64, 40, 32, 78, 49, 21, 81 functions→approved trip/alarm matrix.The identifiers are functional labels, not proof of implemented coverage.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Generator backup/abnormal protection main zone બહાર/ capability બહારની conditions જુએ અને system recovery સાથે coordinate કરે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Thermaloverload I/T/time capability; RTD/cooling/negative-sequence જુદાં inputs.
  • Backup Ztime/swing/load supervision થી external backup; load ને short નમાનો.
  • Underfrequency turbine/time, load shedding/is landing coordinate; દર dip પર instant trip grid ખરાબકરી શકે.
  • CT/VT/RTD/binary→ADC/logic→87G, 64, 40, 32, 78, 49, 21, 81→trip/alarm matrix; labels coverage proof નથી.

title.en: 4.5 Class A, B, C: declare the plant trip matrix
title.gu: 4.5 Class A, B, C: Plant Trip Matrix સ્પષ્ટ કરો

h.en: Class A, B, C: declare the plant trip matrix
h.gu: Class A, B, C: Plant Trip Matrix સ્પષ્ટ કરો

body.en:
Definition

A generator trip class is a plant-defined grouping of initiating conditions and required coordinated outputs; the letter alone is not a universal international cause-and-effect standard.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Illustrative teaching convention: Class Ainternal electrical severe fault→rapid generator/field isolation and prime-mover shutdown; actual boundaries include the plant’s approved transformer/unit logic.
  • Illustrative Class Bprime-mover/mechanical problem→turbine action first, then generator isolation through approved low-forward/reverse-power sequence where designed.Class Bdefinitions vary at other plants.
  • Illustrative Class Cexternal grid/switchyard condition→grid separation, with house-load/island operation only if plant design permits.Do not assume every hydro/thermal unit can survive is landing.
  • Alarm examples may include first rotor earth, first-stage high temperature, DC supervision or cooling warning; severity/stages and operator actions must come from the actual matrix.
  • Always record initiating relay, trip class, breaker/field/prime-mover outputs, latch/reset, breaker-failure initiation and alarm.Aclass list without outputs is incomplete.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Generator trip class plant-defined conditions/outputs નું group છે; letter પોતે universal standard નથી.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Illustrative A: severe internal electrical→generator/field isolate/prime mover shutdown; actual unit matrix મુજબ.
  • Illustrative B: mechanical/prime mover→turbine action પહેલાં/પછી approved low forward-reverse power sequence; બીજાં plant માં B જુદુંહોઈશકે.
  • Illustrative C: external grid→separation; house-load/island માત્ર design permit કરેતો; દર unit capable નમાનો.
  • Alarm examples first rotor earth, firststage T/DC/cooling warning; actual severity/action matrix થી.
  • Initiator, class, CB/field/prime outputs, latch/reset, BF/alarm લખો; outputs વિન aclasslist અપૂર્ણ.

title.en: 4.6 Hydro and thermal utility generator schemes
title.gu: 4.6 Hydro તથા Thermal Utility Generator Schemes

h.en: Hydro and thermal utility generator schemes
h.gu: Hydro તથા Thermal Utility Generator Schemes

body.en:
Definition

A utility generator scheme coordinates electrical machine, step-up transformer, neutral, excitation and prime-mover protection through a documented power/control architecture.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Illustrative hydro: 100 MVA, 11k V, 50 Hz, CT 6000/1A, VT 11k V/110 Vline-line, 110 Vstation DC; neutral method/stator coverage and turbine/water-system trip matrix are study inputs.
  • Illustrative thermal: 250 MVA, 15.75k V, 50 Hz, CT 10000/1A, VT 15.75k V/110V, 220 VDC; coordinate steam/turbine, excitation and generator-transformer protection.
  • Primary: neutral/CT→stator→terminal CT/GCB where fitted→GT→grid.Control: numerical/static elements→lockout/sequence logic→GCB/HV breaker, field and authorised prime-mover interfaces.
  • Generator-breaker asymmetry/interrupting duty, insulation, earthing, DC redundancy, CT s atu ration and permitted house-load require actual specifications; these example ratings are not procurement approvals.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. Balanced rated current I=S/(√3 VLL).The illustrative 100 MVA 11k Vunit gives≈5248.6A; 250 MVA 15.75k Vgives≈9164.3A before overload/thermal allowance.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Utility generator scheme machine, transformer, neutral, excitation/prime mover ને documented power-control થી coordinate કરે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Illustrative hydro 100 MVA/11k V/50 Hz/CT 6000/1A/VT 11k V/110 Vline-line/DC 110V; neutral/coverage/water trip study inputs.
  • Illustrative thermal 250 MVA/15.75k V/50 Hz/CT 10000/1A/VT 15.75k V/110V/DC 220V; steam/turbine/field-GT coordinate.
  • Primary neutral/CT→stator→terminal CT/fitted GCB→GT→grid; control relay→lockout/sequence→GCB-HV/field/prime mover.
  • GCB asymmetry, duty, insulation/earthing, DC redundancy, CT/house-load actual specs જોઈએ; examples procurement approval નથી.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. I=S/(√3 VLL); 100 MVA 11k V માં≈5248.6A/250 MVA 15.75k V માં≈9164.3A, before allowance.

title.en: 4.7 Induction motor faults and protection layers
title.gu: 4.7 Induction Motor Faults તથા Protection Layers

h.en: Induction motor faults and protection layers
h.gu: Induction Motor Faults તથા Protection Layers

body.en:
Definition

Motor protection detects electrical, thermal and mechanical abnormalities that can damage the motor or driven process while allowing the approved starting and running duty.

Classification / scope

  • Internal fault; thermal abnormality; supply abnormality; starting/mechanical abnormality—select layers by motor/process criticality.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Faults: phase/earth short, winding insulation failure.Abnormalities: overload, stall/locked rotor, phase loss/unbalance, low voltage, excess starts and cooling failure.
  • Short-circuit protection, overload model, earth-fault, negative-sequence, stall/start supervision and process interlocks serve different functions.Acontactor is not automatically a short-circuit breaker.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Motor protection approved start/run ને allow કરી electrical, thermal/mechanical damage conditions શોધે છે.

વર્ગીકરણ / વ્યાપ

  • Internal/thermal/supply/start-mechanical classes; criticality મુજબ layers.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Faults phase-earth short/insulation; abnormal overload, stall, phase loss/unbalance, low V, start/cooling.
  • Short, thermal, EF, negative-sequence, stall/start/process જુદા; contact or automatic fault breaker નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Negative-sequence motor protection responds to unbalanced phase quantities that create a reverse rotating field and severe rotor heating; thermal protection tracks cumulative heating/cooling.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Negative-sequence rotor field has high relative frequency during normal forward running, so small voltage unbalance can produce disproportionate current/heating.
  • Use I2/I1 or I 2²tcapability as defined by motor/relay, with phase-loss and CT fault supervision.Thermal memory must not be reset simply to force a hot restart.
  • RTD/bearing temperature, cooling and start count supplement current models; one universal overload curve does not fit every motor.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. With a=e^(j 120°), one convention is I1=(Ia+a Ib+a²Ic)/3, I2=(Ia+a²Ib+a Ic)/3; phase order/polarity must be stated.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Negative-sequence motor protection unbalance થી reverse field/rotor heat શોધે; thermal cumulative heat-cooling જુએ છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Normal forward માં reversefieldhighrelativef આપે; small V unbalance થી large I/heat થઈશકે.
  • I2/I1/I 2²tactualcapability થી; phase loss/CT s upervision; hot restart માટે memory reset નહીં.
  • RTD, bearing, cooling/start count models ને supplement; universal curve નહીં.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. a=e^(j 120°)માં I1=(Ia+a Ib+a²Ic)/3/I2=(Ia+a²Ib+a Ic)/3; order/polarity declare.

h.en: Motor OC, earth fault and stall/start supervision
h.gu: Motor OC, Earth Fault તથા Stall/Start Supervision

body.en:
Definition

Stall/start protection distinguishes permitted acceleration current from a failed or prolonged acceleration/locked-rotor condition using current, time and where available speed/process feedback.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Instantaneous OC must tolerate permitted start yet clear high short-circuit current; thermal/start-time elements protect the lower prolonged current region.
  • EF uses residual phase CT s or CBCT with grounding-compatible sensitivity; stall may use high current plus low speed/long start or a thermal model.
  • Loss of load, low voltage, reacceleration and multiple starts need process-specific logic.Do not suppress a real jam by increasing stall time without mechanical/thermal review.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Stall/start protection current, time/speed થી permitted acceleration ને failed/locked rotor થીઅલગકરે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Instant OC start tolerate/high fault clear; thermal/start time prolonged current cover.
  • EF residual/CBCT/grounding સાથે; stallhigh I+low speed/long start/thermal થી.
  • Loss load, low V, reaccel/start process logic; jam છુપાવવાસમય blindly વધારવોનહીં.

body.en:
Definition

A motor protection scheme combines a rated switching/short-circuit device, measurement, thermal/fault functions and safe control interlocks for the actual motor duty.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Illustrative 415 Vmotor: 30k W, η0.90, PF 0.85, 50 Hz; I≈54.6A.Choose CT 100/1 Aonly as a study candidate; breaker/contact or/overload coordination and available fault duty remain mandatory.
  • Illustrative 6.6k Vmotor: 1 MW, η0.95, PF 0.9, 50 Hz; I≈102.3A, CT 150/1A, VT 6.6k V/110 Vand MV vacuum device as candidates; EF, thermal, negative-sequence, start/stall and possibly differential per risk.
  • Primary: source→short-circuit device→contact or/CB→CT→motor; EF sensor encloses the correct conductors.Control: stop/healthy permits→start/latch→coil; protection trip breaks the run path and records cause.
  • Numerical motor relay combines models/measurements but must retain independent suitable emergency-stop/safety design and anti-restart logic.Actual 400V/6.6k V equipment is not student DIY.

Assumptions and ordered derivation

  1. For output-rated motor power, Pout=√3 VLLIηPF; I=Pout/(√3 VLLηPF).This differs from using electrical input power directly.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Motor scheme actual duty માટે rated switching, measurement, thermal/fault/safe interlocks જોડે છે.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Illustrative 415V 30k W/η0.90/PF 0.85/50 Hz માં I≈54.6A; CT 100/1 Acandidate જ; CB-contact or-overload/fault study જરૂરી.
  • Illustrative 6.6k V 1 MW/η0.95/PF 0.9/50 Hz માં I≈102.3A/CT 150/1A/VT 6.6k V/110V/MV vacuum candidate; EF, thermal, negative/start-stall/required diff.
  • Primary source→fault device→contact or-CB→CT→motor; EF proper conductors; control stop/healthy→start-latch→coil/trip run path break.
  • Numerical models સાથે independent safety stop/anti-restart જોઈએ; actual 400V/6.6k VDIY નહીં.

ધારણાઓ તથા ક્રમબદ્ધ Derivation

  1. Output rating માં Pout=√3 VLLIηPF થી I=Pout/(√3 VLLηPF); input power થીજુદું.

body.en:
Definition

A source-listed supervised performance guide, not a claim that a test, reading, date or instructor signature has been completed.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Approved voltage/current phasor injection or protected generator trainer, relay, timer and isolated output monitor.
  2. Declare export-positive real power; use correct phase associations and block mechanical/generator actual trip interfaces.

Working / operating sequence

  1. Read the actual device manual, ratings, settings and approved safe plan; identify energy sources, trip destinations and all blocked/isolation boundaries.
  2. Power OFF: check instrument ranges, polarity, burdens, CT test blocks, grounding and output isolation; no interlock/protection bypass.
  3. Inject forward, near-zero and reverse power points at stated V/I; verify pickup/time with current/voltage limits.
  4. Test brief reverse transient rejection and sustained reverse operation; capture actual sign, delay and output records.
  5. Write actual readings with units, test conditions, quality and evidence only after genuine performance; computed traces stay in separate labelled columns.
  6. Return settings/links to the documented authorised state, isolate/discharge, and close the instructor checklist without inventing observations.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Official practical 8; source Unit/CO 4; 2 suggested hours.No individual compulsory star is marked.
  • Use offline models or approved isolated secondary injection under qualified supervision; 24 VDC mock construction does not authorise high-energy relay/CT/VT tests.Source variac is not isolation.

Worked example / setting interpretation

  1. For declared base 100 MVA, −2 MW threshold is an illustrative 2%base example only; prime-mover limits set actual values.

Reliability and safety checks

  • False reverse result may be voltage phase mismatch or polarity; never deliberately motor a real generator without the plant’s specialised approved procedure.
  • Never open a live CT s econdary, short a VT s econdary, lift protective earth or attach unsafe scope grounds.Actual switchyard operations require site authority/permit.

Blank actual observation record

————
————
————

Date / તારીખ: ______ Instructor / સહી: ______
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Source-listed supervised પ્રયોગમાર્ગદર્શિકા છે; test/readings/date/signature પૂર્ણથયાનો દાવો નથી.

Construction / ભાગો તથા જોડાણ

  1. Approved phasor injection/guarded trainer/relay-timer-monitor.
  2. Export-positive/phase match; actual turbine-generator trip interfaces block.

Working / કાર્યનો ક્રમ

  1. Actual manual, ratings/settings/safe plan વાંચો; sources/trip destinations/isolation ઓળખો.
  2. OFF માં ranges, polarity, burden, CT blocks, earth/output isolation check; protection bypass નહીં.
  3. Stated V-I માં forward/zero/reverse points/pickup-time verify.
  4. Brief transient reject/sustained reverse operate/sign-delay-output record.
  5. ખરેખરપ્રયોગપછી actual readings units/conditions/evidence સાથેલખો; computed trace અલગ label માં.
  6. Settings/links authorised state માંપરત/isolate-discharge/checklist close; readings invent નહીં.

વિગતવાર સમજણ તથા અર્થઘટન

  • Official પ્રયોગ 8; source Unit/CO 4; 2 suggested hours; individual compulsory star નથી.
  • Offline model/qualified supervised isolated injection જ; 24 Vmock થી high-energy CT-VT test permission નહીં; variacisolation નથી.

ઉકેલેલું ઉદાહરણ / Settingનું અર્થઘટન

  1. Base 100 MVA/−2 MW illustrative 2% જ; actual prime mover limit મુજબ.

વિશ્વસનીયતા તથા સલામતી

  • False માં phase/polarity જોવો; special approval વિન arealgeneratormotor નહીં.
  • Live CT open/VT short/protective earth remove/unsafe scope ground નહીં; actual switchyard authority-permit થી.

Actual Observation માટે ખાલી Record

Date / તારીખ: ______ Instructor / સહી: ______

body.en:
Definition

A source-listed supervised performance guide, not a claim that a test, reading, date or instructor signature has been completed.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Approved isolated motor-relay test kit or guarded motor trainer, CT base/motor data, thermal/start settings and event capture.
  2. Use input mappings and declared motor model; separate emergency-stop safety from normal protection logic.

Working / operating sequence

  1. Read the actual device manual, ratings, settings and approved safe plan; identify energy sources, trip destinations and all blocked/isolation boundaries.
  2. Power OFF: check instrument ranges, polarity, burdens, CT test blocks, grounding and output isolation; no interlock/protection bypass.
  3. Test overload/time, phase loss/unbalance, EF and start/stall conditions by approved injection or simulation, not by jamming a live shaft.
  4. Verify thermal memory, hot-start block and reset/anti-restart behaviour using simulated states; record model/relay differences.
  5. Write actual readings with units, test conditions, quality and evidence only after genuine performance; computed traces stay in separate labelled columns.
  6. Return settings/links to the documented authorised state, isolate/discharge, and close the instructor checklist without inventing observations.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Official practical 9; source Unit/CO 4; 2 suggested hours.No individual compulsory star is marked.
  • Use offline models or approved isolated secondary injection under qualified supervision; 24 VDC mock construction does not authorise high-energy relay/CT/VT tests.Source variac is not isolation.

Worked example / setting interpretation

  1. Rated output power requires I=Pout/(√3VηPF); do not omitηwhen Poutis shaft rating.

Reliability and safety checks

  • No trip: check input scale, setting group, active/start state and output map; do not reset thermal memory to force a hot start.
  • Never open a live CT s econdary, short a VT s econdary, lift protective earth or attach unsafe scope grounds.Actual switchyard operations require site authority/permit.

Definition

A source-listed supervised performance guide, not a claim that a test, reading, date or instructor signature has been completed.

Construction / parts and connections

  1. Static differential relay, approved isolated dual-current source, contact monitor and CT polarity sheet.
  2. Into-zone phasors and matched phase circuits represent terminal/neutral currents; no connection to actual generator CT s econdaries.

Working / operating sequence

  1. Read the actual device manual, ratings, settings and approved safe plan; identify energy sources, trip destinations and all blocked/isolation boundaries.
  2. Power OFF: check instrument ranges, polarity, burdens, CT test blocks, grounding and output isolation; no interlock/protection bypass.
  3. Inject through-load/opposite phasors and external mismatch to demonstrate stability limits.
  4. Inject internal/additive phasors and determine pickup/time within the relay’s manual limits; compare to static architecture.
  5. Write actual readings with units, test conditions, quality and evidence only after genuine performance; computed traces stay in separate labelled columns.
  6. Return settings/links to the documented authorised state, isolate/discharge, and close the instructor checklist without inventing observations.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Official practical 10; source Unit/CO 4; 2 suggested hours.No individual compulsory star is marked.
  • Use offline models or approved isolated secondary injection under qualified supervision; 24 VDC mock construction does not authorise high-energy relay/CT/VT tests.Source variac is not isolation.

Worked example / setting interpretation

  1. Equal opposite currents ideally cancel; equal additive into-zone currents double the operating magnitude.

Reliability and safety checks

  • Unexpected trip: check current phase, burden and auxiliary supply rather than assuming the stator has failed.
  • Never open a live CT s econdary, short a VT s econdary, lift protective earth or attach unsafe scope grounds.Actual switchyard operations require site authority/permit.

Definition

An offline calculation/logic exercise with declared assumptions; it does not connect to hardware, issue real trip commands or approve settings.

Detailed explanation and interpretation

  • Use the worked examples and formulas in the corresponding Notes/Practical guide.Keep calculated output separate from actual measured readings.
  • The self-contained HTML preview has optional interactive controls; the source card retains this explanation for content readers without script execution.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

આ declared assumptions વાળું offline calculation/logic exercise છે; hardware connection, real trip command અથવા setting approval આપતું નથી.

q.en: First and second rotor earth faults?
q.gu: Rotor ના first તથા second earth fault?

a.en: Afirst earth on an otherwise isolated rotor circuit may not create a large fault current but removes isolation security.Asecond earth can short field turns, unbalance flux and cause severe damage; response follows the plant design.
a.gu: Isolated rotor પર first earth માં મોટો I ન પણ થાય, પણ isolation security ખોવાય; second earth field turns short/flux imbalance કરી શકે; plant matrix અનુસરો.

a.en: Afundamental neutral/residual method can have a near-neutral blind region.A 100%scheme uses suitable additional principles such as third-harmonic or injection, with actual coverage verified for the generator/earthing.
a.gu: Fundamental method માં near-neutral blind region હોઈ શકે; 100% scheme માં third-harmonic/injection વગેરે અને actual earthing-specific verification જોઈએ.

a.en: No.It measures signed real power relative to the export convention.Reactive power can change without motoring; correct V/Iphase association and time threshold are essential.
a.gu: નહીં.Export-sign પ્રમાણે real power માપાય છે; VAR બદલાય એટલે motoring નહીં; સાચી V/I phase association/time જોઈએ.

q.en: Loss of excitation versus pole slip?
q.gu: Loss of excitation તથા pole slip?

a.en: Loss of field changes excitation/VAR and impedance behaviour.Pole slip is loss of synchronism; they can be related but are not identical and stable power swings must be distinguished.
a.gu: Field loss excitation/VAR/impedance બદલે; pole slip synchronism loss છે; સંબંધ હોઈ શકે પણ એકજ નથી; stable swing જુદો ઓળખો.

a.en: No.The notes declare one illustrative plant convention; different plants use different labels and sequences.The approved cause-and-effect matrix, prime-mover limits and is landing capability govern actual outputs.
a.gu: નહીં.Notes માં એક illustrative convention છે; plants માં labels/sequence જુદાં હોઈ શકે; approved matrix/prime-mover/is landing capability જ અનુસરો.

q.en: Why is negative sequence harmful to motors?
q.gu: Motor માટે negative sequence નુકસાનકારક કેમ?

a.en: It creates an opposing rotating field causing high relative-frequency rotor currents and heating.Small voltage unbalance can cause substantial current unbalance; I2/thermal limits need actual motor data.
a.gu: Opposing field થી rotor માં high-relative-frequency current/heat થાય; થોડા voltage unbalance થી વધારે current unbalance થઈ શકે; actual motor limits જોઈએ.

a.en: High current is expected during valid acceleration.Stall logic uses allowed start/locked-rotor time, thermal state and optionally speed, so it must avoid rejecting a healthy start while preventing overheating.
a.gu: Valid start માં high I normal છે; stall logic time/thermal/optional speed વાપરે; healthy start allow/overheat prevent બંને જોઈએ.

q.en: Why include efficiency in motor current?

a.en: If rating is shaft output, electrical input is Pout/η, hence I=Pout/(√3VηPF).Omittingηunderestimates current; this calculation does not alone approve a CT, cable or protection setting.
a.gu: Shaft Pout માટે input=Pout/η એટલે I=Pout/(√3VηPF); η કાઢવાથી I ઓછો આવે; આ ગણતરી એકલી CT/cable/setting approval નથી.
